mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing clear skies at Fireman's Park with a temperature of 39 degrees, though it feels like 32. We are also under a new moon tonight.

In city news, crews will begin pavement repairs on November 10 and 11. Streets like Morningside Boulevard and Mozart Street will be affected with no parking allowed between 7 AM and 7 PM. Additionally, the Plan Commission is reviewing a development proposal for Sub-Zero at Liberty Business Park on December 7.
There is plenty to do in Verona! You can catch live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard, or head out tomorrow for yoga at Insight Wellness and more live music at Wisconsin Brewing Company.
Looking at the weekly police report, on October 25, officers arrested a 40-year-old Verona man for O W I after he was discovered stopped at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
It is time for the Culver's flavor of the day! Today's delicious pick is Snickers Swirl, and the restaurant opens today at 10:00 AM.
